title: 2.4.8 do...while: Count 1 to 5
description: Write a do...while loop that prints 1 through 5, then a second one whose condition starts false and still runs once. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Count 1 to 5
steps.instructions: Write a do...while loop that logs the numbers 1 through 5. Declare a counter, log it inside the loop, then update it before the while condition checks it.

steps.title: A do...while whose condition starts false
steps.instructions: Write a second do...while loop with a condition that is already false before the loop starts (for example, a counter that starts at 10 and a condition like counter < 0). Confirm in your console output that the body still runs exactly once.

requirements.title: closing while present
requirements.description: Code contains the closing while condition of a do...while loop
